{{Top|leg}}
The '''Park of Peace''' was a three-[[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] open park stretching through the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Derilysa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Villis Andal]]'s sector home, [[Moff's Palace]] was located at the northern end of the park, while [[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]]'s [[Government Palace]] was located at the southern end.
